Round 94d: Phylactery Serif, the picked font as a real font

Your pick: "75% IM Fell English and 25% EB Garamond it is [...] that's the font." It is now a TrueType font, files/PhylacterySerif-Regular.ttf (master copy in lich-survivors/identity/font/, built by tools/blend_font.py): 141 characters (space included), every glyph blended outline to outline exactly as in the row you picked (4, 6, 9 and ç through distance fields, their two versions being built differently), metrics and kerning blended the same way. Licence: SIL OFL 1.1 like both parents, both copyrights kept (files/OFL.txt); free for the game, the store and anything else. The wordmark masters (tools/wordmark.py) are set in it with the font's own kerning and default spacing; tracking, colour and any hand-tuning of single letters belong to the logo round.
